items.title: Shah raises climate risks and Bhotekoshi disaster with Guterres
items.summary: PM seeks UN support for riverbank resettlement, green reconstruction and an extension of Nepal’s LDC graduation timeline.

items.title: Rasuwa flash floods recede, health risks loom
items.summary: Reliable systems for providing safe drinking water, sustained hygiene promotion and community awareness programmes are urgently needed.

items.title: At UN, Prime Minister Balendra Shah to make Nepal’s case for climate justice
items.summary: Shah will cite the Bhotekoshi flood devastation and ask wealthy nations to provide more money, technology and support for reconstruction.

items.title: NEA working on winter power management
items.summary: Officials say there won’t be load-shedding this winter despite flood damage to hydropower infrastructure along Trishuli corridor.

items.title: Bhotekoshi floods prompt ADB to cut Nepal’s growth forecast to 4.1 percent
items.summary: The Asian Development Bank has raised its inflation forecast to 5.3 percent and expects the fiscal deficit to widen as reconstruction spending increases following the devastation.
